These are the source-of-truth entries for the device SQLite DB.
If players need to be re-entered (new install, DB reset), use these exact values.
Stats reflect the most recent confirmed screenshot (may be slightly higher than calibration
observations due to ongoing training — tier changes are deterministic, training is incremental).
Roles: enter ALL roles in the position grid (max 3) — not just the primary role.
Using only the primary role gives a narrower white stat set, reducing projection accuracy.
